status: fixed_before_new_fits; post-hoc development exploration after V1 final and V2 H1/H3 were viewed
purpose: Test stronger Ridge regularization and two separate causal OHLCV feature increments before neural training
target: next SRT raw close-to-close log return, unchanged
evaluation_calendar: the same 378 target dates as V1; reject changed or missing dates
base_features: the original six V1 features in their saved order
missing_policy: A valid zero volume maps to log1p(0)=0; missing and negative volumes are invalid. Missing/nonpositive prices invalidate the window; no future fill. All comparisons require the unchanged development calendar.
alpha_selection: inner training fit and inner stop raw-return RMSE; choose larger alpha on exact tie; full outer training refit
primary_comparison: each feature group against Z0 and same-grid base Ridge on identical dates, pooled RMSE and MAE
screen_advance: one group has at least 1% lower pooled RMSE than Z0, at least two of three folds better than Z0, and pooled MAE no worse than 1% over Z0; then run matched neural comparisons separately
scope_limit: one grid and two separate feature groups only; no combined group, no final_holdout evaluation, no trading selection
interpretation: development evidence only; a positive screen is a candidate for matched neural tests and fresh unseen data, not independent optimization proof
